scripts/spot_client/spot_interface.py

Boston Dynamics Python-SDK facade. Owns lease, e-stop, power, state and command clients.

Module constants

VELOCITY_CMD_DURATION = 0.6

End time, in seconds, attached to every SDK command so a dropped packet cannot leave the robot walking.

MAX_YAW = 0.5
MAX_PITCH = 0.5

Joint-safe saturation in radians (paper: \(0.52\,\mathrm{rad}\)).

class SpotInterface(image_source)
Parameters:

image_source (str) – "ZED" or "SPOT".

Connects to 10.0.0.3 on the payload LAN. Edit the constructor before using another address or account.

_toggle_estop()

Start or stop the EstopKeepAlive thread. Initial state is ON.

_orientation_cmd_helper(yaw=0.0, roll=0.0, pitch=0.0, height=0.0)

synchro_stand_command with EulerZXY body offset.

_velocity_cmd_helper(v_x=0.0, v_y=0.0, v_rot=0.0)

synchro_velocity_command with the mobility params from _set_mobility_params().

set_controls(controls)
Parameters:

controls – [dyaw, dpitch, _, v_x, v_y, v_rot].

Accumulates pitch/yaw, clips to ±MAX_*, stores the three velocities and sends a velocity command that also carries the body offset through mobility params.

_start()

Take the lease, configure e-stop, power on, blocking_stand. If image_source == "SPOT", construct the optional Stitch helper.

shutdown()

Zero the body offset, sit, safe-power-off, stop keep-alives.

get_image()

One stitched onboard frame (SPOT source only).
